neither ... nor: He neither called me nor sent a message after the meeting ended.
会议结束后他既没给我打电话也没发消息。
teammate: My teammate passed the ball to me and I scored the final point.
我的队友把球传给我，我得到了最后的一分。
rather than: She chose to walk to school rather than take the crowded bus.
她选择步行去学校，而不是乘坐拥挤的公交车。
pull together: If we all pull together, we can finish cleaning the classroom before noon.
如果我们齐心协力，就能在中午之前打扫完教室。
Bert: Bert promised to help his younger brother with his math homework tonight.
伯特答应今晚帮弟弟做数学作业。
Holly: Holly spent the whole afternoon practicing the piano for the school show.
霍莉整个下午都在为学校演出练习钢琴。
backpack: I put my books and water bottle into my backpack before leaving home.
出门前我把书和水瓶装进了背包。
give ... a lift: My father said he could give me a lift to the train station.
我爸爸说他可以开车捎我去火车站。
disbelief: She stared at the winning ticket in complete disbelief for a long moment.
她久久地盯着那张中奖彩票，完全不敢相信。
take off: The plane will take off in twenty minutes, so please sit down quickly.
飞机二十分钟后起飞，请赶快坐好。
hoax: The news about the school closing turned out to be a silly hoax.
关于学校要关闭的消息结果竟是一个无聊的骗局。
embarrassing: It was really embarrassing when I forgot my teacher's name in front of everyone.
当着所有人的面忘记老师的名字，真是太难堪了。
New Zealand: My cousin moved to New Zealand last year and loves the fresh air there.
我表哥去年搬到了新西兰，很喜欢那里清新的空气。
Carl: Carl always arrives at the library early to get his favorite seat.
卡尔总是早早到图书馆，以占到他喜欢的座位。
Orson: Orson told us an interesting story about his trip to the mountains.
奥森给我们讲了一个关于他山区旅行的有趣故事。
fin: The shark's fin cut through the water as it swam closer to the boat.
鲨鱼游近小船时，它的鳍划开了水面。
reusable: We should bring reusable bags when we go shopping to reduce plastic waste.
我们购物时应该自带可重复使用的袋子，以减少塑料垃圾。
upside down: The little boy held the map upside down and couldn't find the street.
小男孩把地图拿倒了，找不到那条街。
WildAid: WildAid works hard to stop people from buying products made from wild animals.
野生救援协会努力阻止人们购买野生动物制品。
WWF: The WWF protects endangered animals and their homes around the world.
世界野生生物基金会保护世界各地的濒危动物及其栖息地。
Jason: Jason fixed his old bicycle by himself and rode it to school the next day.
杰森自己修好了旧自行车，第二天就骑着它上学了。
Ken: Ken wants to join the basketball club because he loves playing sports.
肯想加入篮球俱乐部，因为他热爱运动。
Hayes: Mrs. Hayes teaches us English and always encourages us to speak bravely.
海斯老师教我们英语，总是鼓励我们勇敢开口说。
Jessica: Jessica made a beautiful birthday card for her best friend last weekend.
杰茜卡上周末为她最好的朋友做了一张漂亮的生日贺卡。
in a row: Our team has won five games in a row this season.
我们队本赛季已经连续赢了五场比赛。
make a mess: The children made a mess in the kitchen while trying to bake cookies.
孩子们试着烤饼干时把厨房弄得一团糟。
keep one’s cool: Try to keep your cool when the exam questions seem too difficult.
当考试题目看起来太难时，要尽量保持冷静。
senior high (school): My sister will enter senior high school next September after the summer holiday.
我妹妹暑假过后将在明年九月升入高中。
believe in: If you believe in yourself, you can achieve your dream step by step.
如果你相信自己，就能一步一步实现梦想。
be responsible for: Each student should be responsible for keeping his own desk clean and tidy.
每个学生都应该对自己课桌的干净整洁负责。
Brian: Brian read the whole novel in two days because the story was exciting.
布莱恩两天读完了整本小说，因为故事很精彩。
Luke: Luke helped the old lady carry her heavy bags to the bus stop.
卢克帮那位老太太把沉重的袋子提到了公交站。
Griffin: Mr. Griffin showed us some photos of his farm in the countryside.
格里芬先生给我们看了他乡下农场的一些照片。
Trent: Trent practiced running every morning to prepare for the school sports meeting.
特伦特每天早上练习跑步，为学校运动会做准备。
first of all: First of all, you should check your answers before handing in the paper.
首先，交卷之前你应该检查一遍答案。
lost and found box: Someone found my keys and put them in the lost and found box.
有人捡到了我的钥匙，把它们放进了失物招领箱。
be careful with: Be careful with the hot water when you make tea in the kitchen.
在厨房泡茶时要小心热水。
from now on: From now on, I will spend thirty minutes reading English every evening.
从现在开始，我每天晚上要花三十分钟读英语。
here is/are ⋯: Here are the photos you asked me to bring to class today.
这是你让我今天带到班里来的照片。
mobile phone: Please turn off your mobile phone before the movie begins.
电影开始前请关掉你的手机。
